# CLI reference

`infoforge [--version] [--config PATH] <command> ...`

## Global options

| Argument | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` `PATH` | config file to use (default: $INFOFORGE_CONFIG, then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/infoforge/config.yaml, then ~/.config/infoforge/config.yaml) |  |

## Questions that start with a dash

For `ask` and `search`, only the command's own flags (listed below) are flags; everything else is part of the question, so `infoforge search -5 degrees in kelvin` and `infoforge search --version` search for exactly that text. Flags may come before or after the question. A literal `--` ends flag parsing explicitly: `infoforge search --json --text -- "-5 degrees"`. Callers that pass user text should always put `--` before it.

## Exit codes

See [errors.md](errors.md) for the full table; in short: 0 ok, 1 doctor found a failing check, 2 config/usage/infrastructure, 3 no sources, 4 `--strict` uncited, 5 LLM unreachable, 6 not in the sources.

## `infoforge ask`

Answer a question from local zim sources.

```text
infoforge ask question [question ...] [--json] [--strict] [--max-articles N]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `question` | the question; anything that is not an ask flag is part of it (use -- to be explicit) |  |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |  |
| `--strict` | exit 4 if the answer cites none of the sources (exit 6, not-in-sources, applies with or without it) |  |
| `--max-articles` `N` | override max_articles from the config |  |

## `infoforge search`

Retrieval only: show the sources.

```text
infoforge search question [question ...] [--json] [--text] [--no-ensure] [--max-articles N]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `question` | the query; anything that is not a search flag is part of it (use -- to be explicit) |  |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |  |
| `--text` | with --json: include each source's extracted text |  |
| `--no-ensure` | never create/start the kiwix container: fail fast (exit 2, code kiwix_unreachable) if kiwix-serve is down |  |
| `--max-articles` `N` | override max_articles from the config |  |

## `infoforge zimify`

Build a .zim from a folder of docs.

```text
infoforge zimify input_dir [--output FILE] [--title TITLE] [--description DESCRIPTION] [--creator CREATOR] [--publisher PUBLISHER]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `input_dir` |  |  |
| `-o`, `--output` `FILE` | output .zim path (default: <zim_dir>/<dirname>.zim) |  |
| `--title` `TITLE` |  |  |
| `--description` `DESCRIPTION` |  | `Local knowledge base` |
| `--creator` `CREATOR` | zimwriterfs --creator (mandatory metadata) | `InfoForge` |
| `--publisher` `PUBLISHER` | zimwriterfs --publisher (mandatory metadata) | `InfoForge` |
